app.name: NeoMortalSurv
app.tagline: Survival estimate for very-low-birth-weight infants in the NICU
app.loadFailed: The calculator could not load the model description from the server.
app.configMismatch: The calculator and the server disagree about the input fields. The calculator is switched off until this is fixed.

admission.title: At birth / NICU admission
admission.help: Heart rate and SpO₂ are single values taken right after birth, at NICU admission.

diagnoses.title: Confirmed diagnoses
diagnoses.help: Select Yes only when the diagnosis is confirmed. Recalculate when a diagnosis changes.

form.incomplete: Fill in all {{count}} fields to calculate.

errors.invalid: The server did not accept this value.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again in a minute.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
errors.server: The server could not calculate the estimate. Try again.

result.title: Estimated survival
result.empty: Fill in the form and select Calculate. The estimate appears here.
result.probability: Estimated probability of survival to day {{day}}
result.stale: The inputs have changed since this estimate. Select Calculate to update it.
result.curveHelp: Move over the curve, tap it, or use the arrow keys to read a day.
result.lateNote: After day {{day}} few infants in the study were still under observation, so this part of the curve is less certain.
result.tableToggle: Show the curve as a table

warnings.WEIGHT_ABOVE_COHORT: Birth weight is above 1,500 g. Infants above 1,500 g were not included when the model was developed.

limitations.title: Limitations
limitations.cohort: The estimate comes from a single retrospective cohort.
limitations.validation: The model has not been validated externally.
limitations.calibration: Calibration is weaker at day 7, especially when the predicted risk is low.
limitations.judgement: The estimate is not a substitute for clinical judgement.

footer.intendedUse: For research use. Not a substitute for clinical judgement.

report.title: Survival estimate report
report.caseCode: Case code (optional; no names or record numbers)
report.printHint: Opens the browser's print dialog, where the report can also be saved as PDF.
report.empty: There is no estimate to print yet. Fill in the calculator first.

what.title: What it is
what.body: NeoMortalSurv estimates the probability of survival of very-low-birth-weight infants treated in the neonatal intensive care unit. It uses a DeepSurv model, a neural-network form of the Cox proportional-hazards model.

cohort.title: Cohort
cohort.exclusionsText: Infants above 1,500 g and infants with severe congenital malformations.

performance.title: Reported performance on the test set
performance.note: The model has not been validated externally. Calibration was weaker at day 7, mainly at low predicted risk.

use.title: Intended use
use.body: The estimate is intended at NICU admission and again whenever the status of RDS, IVH, NEC or DIC changes. A diagnosis is entered as Yes only when it is confirmed.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.inviteOnly: Accounts are created by the administrator. There is no self-registration. The calculator works without an account.
auth.invalid_credentials: E-mail or password is not correct.
auth.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Sign in again.

save.title: Save this calculation
save.caseCodeHelp: A code you choose yourself, to find this infant's calculations again. Do not enter a name, a national ID number or a medical record number.
save.format: Up to 32 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores; no spaces.

history.title: Saved calculations
history.intro: Only you can see these. Calculations with the same case code are shown together, newest first.
history.confirmDelete: Delete this saved calculation? This cannot be undone.
history.failed: Could not load the saved calculations.
history.notFound: This saved calculation does not exist.
